utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I’ve got the tools sorting and sign-up sheet covered, and the repair drive is set for next Saturday at my garage for lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam—tools and sign-up are great. Let’s hold off saying next Saturday or your garage until Hana/Ira confirm the date, place, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good catch, Leo — I’ll stop sharing the date, place, and repair list until Hana and Ira confirm, and I’ll just focus on sorting tools and drafting the sign-up sheet for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Eli—I'll be at Sam’s garage by 8:30 with the tools and help set up the stations before folks start dropping things off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Gus, that’s just right—thank you. We’ll have you set up the tool station first, then help sort small appliances as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli—I’ll get the tool station laid out first thing, then jump in on sorting the small appliances as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hana, I’m still not fully caught up—Oren mentioned it might be today and that tools are going to Opal, but I need to confirm the date, location, urgent repairs, and helpers before we treat that as settled.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—please confirm whether it’s actually today, where everyone should meet, what repairs are urgent, and who’s helping before we move on it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Hana—I’ll ask Opal and Oren now and won’t pass along anything as definite until I’ve confirmed the date, meeting spot, urgent repairs, and who’s actually available.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Vik, I think the repair drive is today, and I’d better get my spare hammer and those screwdrivers over to Opal before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That matches what I’ve been telling folks, Oren—the drive’s today, and I’ll remind everyone that your hammer and screwdrivers are headed to Opal for the tool collection.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that helps jog my memory. I’ll head over to Opal with the hammer and screwdrivers now before I set them down somewhere silly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rosa, I’m keeping the repair-drive supply list provisional until we confirm things—do you know any tools, tape, screws, or spare parts we definitely have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—please keep it provisional for now; I know we have some basic tape and assorted screws, but I’m still confirming tools and spare parts before we call anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Rosa—I’ll mark basic tape and assorted screws as tentative-confirmed, and leave tools and spare parts pending until you verify them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m interested, Jules, but I’m still waiting on the confirmed hours, volunteer slots, and rain storage before we spread it wider.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense, Pia — I’ll hold off on wider outreach and circle back once I’ve pinned down the hours, slots, and rain storage plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — once those pieces are confirmed, I can help figure out what I’m bringing and whether 8:30 is realistic.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Kira, I’m confirming the repair drive details Leo was going to check with you—today I have tool collection noted, with Oren arriving at 8:30 to check in with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Opal—can you confirm you’re the drop-off spot today, and will Cleo definitely be there at 8:30 to receive Oren’s tools?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I’m the drop-off spot today and I’ll log each tool as it comes in; I have Oren noted for 8:30, but I’d like you or Cleo to confirm Cleo’s exact arrival before I call it definite.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, I’m just on my way to check the noticeboard now, and I’ll come straight back with the confirmed time before we tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Tess — I’ll hold off on spreading anything until you’re back, then we can pin down drop-off hours, shifts, and a rain spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect, Mara — I’ll check the board now and come straight back with the confirmed time so we can sort the rest properly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’ve mostly heard this second-hand, but it sounds like the repair drive is next Saturday at Sam’s garage for small appliances and tools first—do you know what still needs fixing or who needs help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That matches what I’ve heard, Nell—small appliances and tools are confirmed, and safety repairs still come first, but I’d rather keep names off any list until folks opt in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense, Rey—I’ll keep it to categories and supplies for now, and only add names if folks tell me directly they want help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, quick version: repair drive’s Saturday in the community room for small broken household items. Jules or Mara should have the final setup details, because I only skimmed them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo—that helps. I’ll check with Jules or Mara for the setup time so I can work it around pickup and let other parents know accurately.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Faye—if you get the confirmed time, maybe pass it along to the parent group so I don’t garble it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be by the labeled boxes sorting small parts, Mina. I’m keeping quiet today, but you can send simple things my way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Uli—please sort screws, tape, and spare parts into separate labeled boxes, and tell Cleo what’s usable by 8:30.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort the screws, tape, and spare parts, Mina. I’ll point Cleo to the usable box by 8:30.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ira, I’m still catching up, but what I have confirmed is small repairs around appliances and tools, with Oren checking in at 8:30 and Uli able to sort parts or carry things.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane—that helps. I’ll pass along that appliances and tool repairs are confirmed, with Oren checking in at 8:30 and Uli helping sort parts or carry things.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira—just keep it to that confirmed bit for now, and if anyone asks about roofs or front steps, say we’re still checking before announcing anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Oren, the repair drive is set for next Saturday at Sam’s garage, starting with small appliances and tools. I’m helping match volunteers once the repair list is made—are you able to fix anything or help with triage late morning?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Jules—I had it muddled as today, so next Saturday at Sam’s garage it is. I’m not much of a fixer, but I can help with triage late morning and bring my spare hammer and screwdrivers if Opal still needs them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Oren—I'll put you down for late-morning triage and note the hammer and screwdrivers as available. I’ll check whether Opal still needs tools and keep you posted once the repair list firms up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hi Mina—before I pass anything along, can you confirm whether the repair drive is actually at Sam’s garage or the community room, and what items we’re prioritizing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s at the community room, with check-in at the supply table. We’re prioritizing basic tools, tape, screws, spare parts, and any fixable household items people bring in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Mina—so I should tell folks it’s at the community room, check-in at the supply table, and we’re prioritizing basic tools, tape, screws, spare parts, plus fixable household items?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara—I’ll keep it quiet and just make a few one-on-one checks about safety repairs until you’ve got the time and rain plan settled.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey, that’s exactly right—just keep it to quiet safety-repair feelers for now, and I’ll circle back once I’ve confirmed the time, drop-off hours, shifts, and rain storage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Mara. I’ll just ask a couple folks privately what feels urgent, and I won’t mention details until you say they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo — I’m still holding off on telling school families a time until we know for sure; were you able to check with Ira about whether after school is likely?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not confirmed yet, Faye. I only know it’s today and they’re starting with small appliances and tools, so please hold off on sharing a time until Ira confirms the hours.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it, Leo — I’ll hold off on sharing anything with school families until Ira confirms the hours. Thanks for checking, and please send me the time as soon as you hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira, quick repair drive update: it’s on today, and folks are collecting broken small appliances and tools first, but Sam still needs to confirm the exact hours, storage plan, and volunteer slots.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—that helps. I’ll pass along that small appliances and tools are first today, but I’ll note that Sam still needs to confirm hours, storage, and volunteer slots.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Ira—please keep it to that for now so we don’t over-announce before Sam confirms the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Morning, Eli—I’m still treating the location as second-hand since I heard both Sam’s garage and the community room mentioned. Can you confirm where we should point people before I help with labels and the supply list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, point people to Sam’s garage next Saturday; if anything changes, I’ll say so before we make a wider announcement. Labels and the supply list are exactly where I’d like your help, Nell.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks—I’ll point folks to Sam’s garage and keep it clear that you’ll flag any changes. I’ll start on labels and a supply list, especially for the tools Gus said he’s bringing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Sam, I’m keeping the repair-drive supply list provisional until we confirm things—do you know what tools, tape, screws, spare parts, or basics are already on hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — Oren’s bringing a spare hammer and screwdrivers to you at the supply table around 8:30, and I’m sorting what I’ve got in the garage now. I’ll confirm the tape, screws, and spare parts count and send you the list before we mark anything final.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam—I’ll mark Oren’s hammer and screwdrivers as expected at the supply table around 8:30, and keep your tape, screws, and spare parts provisional until your count comes in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m catching up too, but the repair drive is next Saturday at Sam’s garage, focused on small fixes like lamps, appliances, simple furniture, jackets, chairs, and bikes. If you’ve got broken items or tools, bring them by and we’ll get volunteers sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Dane — I’ll be there early with my toolboxes, drill, bits, clamps, tape, fasteners, extension cords, and socket set to help get stations set up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s perfect, Gus—thanks. Please check in with Cleo when you arrive so she can plug you into the setup where the tools are needed most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m interested, Uli, but I don’t want us spreading details until Sam or Mara confirms the drop-off hours, volunteer slots, and rain storage plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That makes sense, Pia. I’ll keep quiet about the details and just be near the boxes to sort parts once Sam or Mara confirms things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli—that helps. I’ll check with Sam or Mara too, and once the hours and rain storage are firm we can sort volunteers without scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Tess, I’m still fuzzy on the exact time, so please go with the noticeboard or Jules/Mara before telling folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Bo — I won’t tell anyone a time until I’ve checked the noticeboard or heard it straight from Jules or Mara.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Tess — I only caught the Saturday/community room part, so I’m glad you’re double-checking the real details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana, glad I caught you—the repair drive is coming together for small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes. If you know anyone who needs help or can lend repair skills, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll point people your way, but can you confirm the date, place, and time before I spread it? I’m also still checking whether urgent home repairs like roof leaks or steps are included, or if this is only small-item fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Hana—please hold off on date, place, and time for now, because I don’t have those confirmed yet. And I’d keep it to small-item fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes unless we hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Noah, I’m tracking repair drive logistics—Saturday at the community room, with tools coming in today and Oren set for 8:30 to check in with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—thanks, Opal, I had the tools-today part but not Saturday at the community room or Oren’s 8:30 with Cleo. I’ll stick to that and not spread any extra details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Noah—just point anyone with working hand tools to today’s collection, and keep Saturday’s community room location for the repair items.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: They’re collecting small fixes—things like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes—so if you know anyone who needs help or can lend repair skills, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll pass that along carefully and point anyone interested back to you. I also heard it may be next Saturday at Sam’s garage, but I’ll tell folks to confirm with you first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Nell—and yes, please have them check with me before counting on the time or place, since I only want to pass along what’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mara, can you confirm the repair drive details for me? I’ve heard Saturday in the community room and also next Saturday at Sam’s garage, so I don’t want to pass along the wrong location.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for checking, Kira — please don’t pass anything along yet, because I’m still confirming the date, location, drop-off hours, shifts, and rain plan before we announce it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it, I’ll hold off on sharing anything until you confirm the final details. Please send me the date, location, hours, shifts, and rain plan when they’re settled.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I’ll bring gloves, my ladder, extra bits, and the labeled toolboxes, and I’ll be there at 8:30 to start on the steps unless the roof crew needs me first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Gus — start on the steps at 8:30, and check with Cleo before switching to the roof crew so we don’t lose track of your tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Mina — I’ll check in with Cleo before I move anywhere, and I’ll keep my tools together by the steps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Rey, before we move anything forward, can we confirm what’s actually settled for the repair drive—date, place, repair priorities, and which volunteers are definite?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What I’ve heard is only that next Saturday at Sam’s garage may be the plan, but I’d treat that as unconfirmed for now. Priorities can stay roof leaks, broken steps, and heating trouble, and I won’t name households until they’ve agreed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that helps. I’ll mark next Saturday at Sam’s garage as tentative, keep those three urgent priorities for now, and wait on any household names until each one agrees.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I’m catching updates while I’m out—last I heard today’s tool collection is underway, with Opal tracking drop-offs, and the drive covers safety repairs plus small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s right, Ira—Opal’s tracking the drop-offs, and I’m keeping the list sorted so we handle safety repairs first, then the smaller fixes in order.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli—that helps. I’ll pass along that Opal’s tracking tools and your list is prioritizing safety repairs before the smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Vik — I’ll add that Oren’s bringing a hammer and screwdrivers to Opal, and I’ll keep times quiet until confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Leo—thanks for keeping it clear and cautious. I’ll keep telling folks appliances and tools come first, and that times are still not confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. If anyone asks, just send them to me for confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Uli—I'm tracking repair drive locations and drop-offs, so tell me where you're headed or what you're bringing and I'll note it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be near the boxes sorting small parts, Opal. I’m not bringing much, just myself and quiet hands if that helps your notes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Uli—I’ll note you by the boxes sorting small parts, helping with quiet hands and no tool drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I might’ve mixed up an earlier rumor, Pia, but Sam says the repair drive is next Saturday at his garage—just lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture fixes for now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Noah—that helps, but before we spread it around, I’d still like Sam or Mara to confirm the drop-off hours, volunteer slots, and what we’ll do if it rains.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, good call—I’ll treat Sam’s garage and next Saturday as the only solid bits for now, and I’ll check with Sam or Mara about hours, volunteers, and the rain plan before telling anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Rosa, I’m catching up late as usual—can you confirm whether the repair drive is today at 8:30 or next Saturday at Sam’s garage before I steer folks wrong?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at Sam’s garage; I’m still waiting on the final hours before we announce a specific time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—Sunday at the community center, hours still pending. I’ll correct Opal and Oren before anyone shows up at Sam’s garage or at 8:30.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Cleo—I’m Oren, and I’ve brought my hammer and screwdrivers like Mina said; am I at the right supply table for check-in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Morning, Oren—yes, you’re at the right table. I’ll mark your hammer and screwdrivers as confirmed on hand; thanks for bringing them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thank you, Cleo—I’ll leave them here with you then, unless you need me to carry them somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Tess! The plan I’ve heard is next Saturday at Sam’s garage, focused first on small appliances and tools, and I’m helping connect handy volunteers with a triage helper once the repair list comes together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Jules, that’s exactly the sort of solid detail I was waiting on—next Saturday at Sam’s garage, small appliances and tools first. I’ll still peek at the noticeboard, but I can start nudging folks to make their repair lists and think about volunteering.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be perfect, Tess—if you hear who’s leaning toward fixing versus bringing items, send them my way so I can match people up without stepping on Sam’s plans.
